summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 fixes for Conactivos HR app. (1) 'Tu lideras con...' leadership card is visible on the employee's OWN /perfil for Juan Pérez — testID own-leadership-card renders 'Conexión, construyendo relaciones' (TU LIDERAS CON... header + text). (2) MoodCard modal still opens, mood-input editable, mood-save-btn saves correctly — mood updated from '😢 Triste' to '🚀 Enfocada test' and persisted. (3) App icon files present: /app/frontend/assets/images/app-icon.png and app-adaptive-icon.png (app.json icon and android.adaptiveIcon.foregroundImage both reference them). Regression after KeyboardProvider addition in app/_layout.tsx and KeyboardAvoidingView from react-native-keyboard-controller: NO bundling errors, NO red screen, 0 console errors across all tested screens. Verified modals/screens open and inputs render: Likes 'Enviar Like' modal (categoría + mensaje), Permisos 'Nueva Solicitud' (1 textarea + Crear Solicitud), Calendario add (2 inputs), Cápsulas 'Nueva Cápsula' (2 inputs + descripción textarea), Metas edit (2 inputs), Empleado edit modal (7 inputs incl. leadership_statement), Hire-date modal (1 input), empleados/nuevo form (5 inputs + hire-date-picker-btn). Login, forgot-password, change-password screens all render and accept inputs correctly after the ScrollView→KeyboardAwareScrollView switch.

minor.issue: (Carried over from iteration_6/7/8, latent) /app/backend/server.py get_current_user uses `except jwt.JWTError:` which doesn't exist on PyJWT — invalid/expired tokens would 500 instead of 401. Not retested this round (frontend-only scope).

action_items: No action needed from main agent for the 3 requested fixes — all verified working.
(Carried over) Fix latent get_current_user bug in /app/backend/server.py: `except jwt.JWTError:` → `except jwt.PyJWTError:` and add `except HTTPException: raise` before it.

(Nice-to-have) Add testIDs on the top-right '+' buttons of Calendario, Cápsulas, Metas, Solicitudes screens — currently had to use coordinate clicks (350,32) because they expose no testID. The modal content has testIDs; only the open-FAB on these admin screens is missing one.

(Nice-to-have, pre-existing) /perfil loadProfile useEffect has `[]` deps and bails on `if (!user) return;` — on a direct URL reload with auth-from-storage, the profile can get stuck on the ActivityIndicator because user is null at first mount and the effect never re-runs. Normal in-app navigation (home → avatar) is fine. Change deps to `[user]`.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx correctly wraps the tree with KeyboardProvider from react-native-keyboard-controller OUTSIDE SafeAreaProvider/AuthProvider — correct placement; no bundling errors observed.

MoodCard.tsx uses KeyboardAvoidingView from react-native-keyboard-controller with behavior='padding' on iOS and 'height' on Android — good. The modal is still a `transparent` RN Modal, which on web is a plain overlay and shows/saves correctly.

perfil.tsx leadership card is correctly guarded by `!!profile.leadership_statement` and uses testID 'own-leadership-card' — exactly what the request asked. Styling (dark card, gold trophy badge, italic white text) matches the empleados/[id].tsx admin view.
Minor: perfil.tsx `useEffect(..., [])` with inner `if (!user) return;` is fragile on direct reload; see action_items.
app.json: icon './assets/images/app-icon.png' and android.adaptiveIcon.foregroundImage './assets/images/app-adaptive-icon.png' — both files exist on disk.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 3 requested fixes verified, 7 regression modals open with inputs, 0 console errors

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Mood on Juan Pérez was updated during test ('🚀 Enfocada test') — harmless, user can change it back.

rca_of_issue: N/A — this was a verification pass, not a bug fix. All 3 requested fixes are confirmed working: (a) Leadership card renders on employee's own /perfil with correct testID and the DB value from /api/users; (b) KeyboardProvider + KeyboardAwareScrollView migration in _layout.tsx, MoodCard, login, forgot-password, change-password, kudos, solicitudes, calendario, capsulas, metas, empleados/[id], empleados/nuevo bundled cleanly and all modals/forms still open with text inputs functional (verified by counting input/textarea elements per modal and by taking screenshots); (c) app.json points to the new custom icons which exist on disk.
